The '''''Nilos''''' was a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], shot down near [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano]] took the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] for its personal use at [[Whisper Base]], before the [[Takeover at Whisper Base|attack]] by [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] members.
